_source: plans/evil-mode-rework/10_SQUADS.md (Part 10: Squads and Groups, Kice 2026-11-18 11:41 PM PT), sections 1-10; mockup 13 (plans/evil-mode-rework/mockups-v4 #s13). Numbers are starting values, none playtested. Squad Traits 8-20 are new (Part 10 §6 names seven of the twenty).

incentives.name: Cut of the Take
incentives.deal: They keep 10% of what they bring in

incentives.name: Glory
incentives.deal: Their Code Name in the paper, a mural at HQ
incentives.bonus: Dread +2 a week in their town; Attack and Raid +10%
incentives.note: The paper and the mural are drawn with the morning paper (D30).

incentives.name: Brotherhood
incentives.deal: They eat together, they stick together
incentives.bonus: Cohesion grows twice as fast; members never poached while together
incentives.note: Poaching comes with the rival team (D9).

incentives.name: Promotion Track
incentives.deal: The best of them moves up first
incentives.cost: Ambition +2 a week for every member

incentives.name: The Cause
incentives.deal: They're doing it for the Goal
incentives.bonus: +10% on Goal-track jobs; Goal Track +1 a week
incentives.cost: Morale −5 if the Goal stalls for 2 weeks
incentives.note: The Goal track comes with the Founding and the takeover paths (D7, D14); until then the Cause has no bonus and no cost.

incentives.name: Fear of the Boss
incentives.deal: They work because they're scared not to
incentives.bonus: Mishaps halved; never refuse a job
incentives.cost: Loyalty can't rise above 50; betrayal risk +10 for its leader

incentives.name: Vengeance
incentives.deal: A named target (a rival Admin, a Gym, a cop)
incentives.cost: Morale −10 a week once the target's gone, until a new one's named
incentives.note: Rival Admins as targets come with the rival team (D9).

incentives.name: Pokémon First
incentives.deal: Their Pokémon get the best of everything
incentives.bonus: Their Pokémon gain Trust +1 a week and +10% XP
incentives.cost: +₽50 a week per member in upkeep
incentives.note: The +10% Pokémon XP waits for crew Pokémon XP (D5's training rooms).

incentives.name: Quiet Work
incentives.cost: No Dread or Regard from their jobs

bands.text: −10% on squad jobs; members may argue
+20%; a downed member's Pokémon fights on; picks a Squad Trait

traits.name: Ghost Shift
traits.text: Their night jobs can't be seen by the police in the World Turn: no Heat from them.

traits.name: Shield Wall
traits.text: +1 defense battle wherever they guard.

traits.name: Money Hands
traits.text: Rackets in their town pay +20%.

traits.name: Breach Team
traits.text: Raids they lead start with the first defender at −25% HP.

traits.name: Talkers
traits.text: Recruits who join while they work the streets come with +1 trait point.

traits.name: Hero's Shadow
traits.text: +15% against the Hero; they report where the Hero is each morning.

traits.name: Old Warehouse
traits.text: +5 Loyalty to every member, forever; one free retry a region.
traits.note: The free retry a region comes with many regions (D15).

traits.name: Iron Nerves
traits.text: +10% on Nerve jobs.

traits.name: Sticky Fingers
traits.text: +10% on Street Crime jobs.

traits.name: Lookouts
traits.text: +10% on Scout; every member's personal Heat cools 1 more a night.

traits.name: Night Owls
traits.text: Squad jobs tire them +5 Fatigue, not +10.

traits.name: Pack Hunters
traits.text: +10% on Catch and Pokémon Care jobs.

traits.name: Welcome Mat
traits.text: New members join with Loyalty +10.

traits.name: Drill Sergeants
traits.text: Every squad job gives each member +1 XP.

traits.name: Shopkeepers
traits.text: Front jobs bring in +15% more money.

traits.name: Bookkeepers
traits.text: Nobody in the squad pockets a cent; Audit the Books +10%.

traits.name: Unbreakable
traits.text: Members' Morale never falls below 30.

traits.name: Street Legends
traits.text: Dread +1 a week in their town.

traits.name: Tunnel Rats
traits.text: Smuggling routes they run can't be stopped at a checkpoint.

traits.name: Blood Oath
traits.text: Members' Loyalty never falls below 20: nobody walks out.

lines.groupDisbanded: {group} is broken up. Its squads keep going.
lines.splitFamily: {squad} was Family. Breaking it up costs everyone Morale {n}.
lines.splitQuit: {name} won't work for anyone else and walks out.
lines.cleared: {squad} has no order: each member keeps their own task.
lines.refuse: {squad} won't do it, Boss. {name}'s line, and they stand with {them}.
lines.cut: {squad} (Cut of the Take) brought back ₽{amount}. They kept ₽{kept}. Nobody's complaining.
lines.longShot: {squad} pulled it off against the odds ({odds}%). Cohesion +{n}.
lines.family: {squad} is Family now: pick their Squad Trait on the Squads page.
lines.leaderless: {squad} has no leader fit to lead it. Pick a new leader on the Squads page.
lines.punished: {name} was punished in front of {squad}. Cohesion {n}.
lines.rescued: {squad} saw the Boss bail {name} out. Cohesion +{n}.
lines.dread: {squad}'s name is on the walls in {town}. Dread +{n}.
lines.goneTarget: {squad} has no one left to hate. Name a new target. Morale {n}.
lines.rackets: {squad} (Money Hands) squeezed ₽{amount} more out of {town}'s rackets.
lines.matched: {a} and {b} are paired up by {name}. They work better side by side.
lines.matchFailed: {name} tried to pair {a} with {b}. They can't stand each other. Morale {n}.
lines.runCrew: {name} ran a crew of {n} tonight: each of them sharper for it.
lines.noLeader: Pick a leader: a Corporal or higher.
lines.locked: Squads open at {word} (Notoriety {need}) with a Corporal or higher.
lines.lockedNoCorporal: You need a Corporal or higher to lead a squad.
lines.full: You run {n} squads already: the HQ allows {cap}.
lines.tooFew: A squad needs at least {n} members, leader included.
lines.tooMany: A {rank} leads {n} at most, leader included.
lines.nameLong: A Code Name is {n} letters at most.
lines.groupLeader: A Group needs an Admin or higher to lead it.
lines.phase: Orders are given in the Morning or the Evening.

strangers: {squad}? We barely know each other's names, Boss.
{name} keeps sitting on his own at {squad}'s table.
Somebody in {squad} ate somebody else's lunch. It's a whole thing.
workmates: {squad} gets the job done. Nobody's sending cards.
{name}: "{squad}'s fine. We nod at each other now."
{squad} has a group chat. Nobody posts in it.
tight: {squad} has a handshake now. It takes eleven seconds.
{name}: "{squad} covers for each other, Boss. Every time."
{squad} was late because they waited for {name}. All of them.
family: {name}: "Touch one of {squad} and you've touched all of us."
{squad} painted their Mark on the HQ door. Nobody asked. Nobody minds.
